name: Xiomorn Rad Trooper

items.name: Crystal Detonation
items.text: All tracking crystals embedded in a creature that the xiomorn trooper can see within 300 feet immediately shatter and are destroyed. For each crystal destroyed in this way, the creature takes 1d12 piercing damage with a DC 37 basic Fortitude save save.

items.name: Fighting Formation
items.text: The trooper Steps and makes a melee Strike. Up to two other xiomorn troopers within 15 feet can Step as a reaction.

items.name: Rad Grenade
items.text:
Requirements The trooper carries a grenade

---
Effect The trooper Interacts to draw their grenade and throw it up to 30 feet. The grenade then explodes in a 10-foot burst. Creatures within the burst take 8d10 poison damage (DC 36 basic Reflex save save). On a failure, the creature is also Sickened 1 (or Sickened 2 on a critical failure).

items.name: Rad Trooper
items.text: The trooper carries a grenade and gains the Rad Grenade ability. If the grenade is in the trooper's possession when the trooper dies, the grenade detonates in a 10-foot emanation centered on the trooper.

items.name: Tracking Crystal
items.text:
After the xiomorn trooper deals damage with a crystal shard Strike, a glowing green crystal embeds itself in the target's body. The crystal sheds dim light for 10 feet. While a creature has at least one crystal embedded in its body, all xiomorn troopers gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks to seek the creature and to Survival checks to track the creature. In addition, all xiomorn troopers gain a +1 circumstance bonus to attack rolls against the creature. A creature can Interact to remove all tracking crystals embedded in themselves or an adjacent creature.

Effect: Tracking Crystal

text:
Xiomorn troopers are an elite military force formed from the ranks of xiomorn vault keepers. Armed with technology only they understand, xiomorn troopers hold the line against those who oppose the mysterious aims of the vault builders.

Many xiomorn troopers possess special training or equipment that helps them perform specific roles within their strike force. Comm troopers, for example, can communicate telepathically with their fellow troopers, while scout troopers surround themselves with fields of light-bending energy on their patrols. The batons of shock troopers carry charges of electricity that they use to stun their foes, while rad troopers are armed with explosives that release bursts of a sickening radiation, to which the troopers themselves are immune.
Mysterious Generals
Some xiomorn troopers consider themselves part of a single military organization led by a figure whose identity is unknown even to the highest-ranking troopers. Referred to only as the "Commander," this mysterious leader hands down orders along an extended, telepathic chain of command. In many Orvian vaults, the Commander is presumed to be a vault builder—or perhaps a fellow trooper in direct contact with the builders—though some troopers insist the Commander is simply an imaginary figurehead created to inspire loyalty. The fact that different squads of troopers have at times been given conflicting orders lends credence to the latter belief.
